info.title: DroidVM WebUI API
info.description: HTTP/WS，同源部署。磁盘条件任务与详情、宿主能力、资源目录、USB 条件目标/规则任务、只读规则预览及配置提交复用原生服务，精确整数大小和偏移使用字符串。完整资源管理与设备验收继续实施。

200.description: Identity scoped current observation.
Identity scoped current observation.

post.description: Administrator/task permissions, Origin/CSRF/context. Freeze runtime generation/state and global configuration revision. Native conditional operation validates under its operation/configuration locks. A changed unrelated network also invalidates the global revision. Unknown receipts must be queried without replay. Stop may disconnect the current browser.

202.description: Accepted, not proof of completion.

200.description: Identity scoped current observation.

post.description: networks.configuration.v1; administrator and task permissions, Origin/CSRF/context. Immutable 8 MiB active configuration snapshot; 48 KiB raw chunks. Upload up to 17 MiB through the same native ConfigUploads pool. Per-network exact expected configuration (null for create) permits unrelated edits. Atomic merge does not delete or start networks. Unknown receipts must only be queried.

200.description: Snapshot, staging or scoped task status with session context.

202.description: 配置提交任务已接纳，不代表已经持久化。

200.description: 持久日志记录数，可能包含活动任务；只读，不触发恢复

post.description: 管理员及任务权限、Origin/CSRF/context；显式尝试原生持久日志恢复，跳过活动记录，不重提原磁盘任务。进入执行后不可取消。

202.description: 恢复任务已接收；剩余记录数见定向任务结果

200.description: 当前身份的恢复任务；null 不证明未执行

post.description: 管理员及任务权限、Origin/CSRF/context；按身份/requestId 去重，再由原生后台任务检查版本、租约、镜像和执行。不得自动重提未知回执。

202.description: 任务已接收；不是镜像操作成功

409.description: 请求标识冲突或上下文变化

200.description: 当前身份关联任务；null 不证明操作未发生

get.description: disks.inspect.v1；管理员按需读取登记关系与镜像信息。使用原生登记保留和文件读租约，镜像忙碌或无法检测不伪装为空闲。返回为观察，不预留未来操作。

200.description: 登记关系及镜像信息观察

409.description: 观察期间配置变化，请重新读取

post.description: 管理员且具有任务权限，所有操作要求 Origin/CSRF/context。规则正文最多 8 MiB，read 每次返回最多 48 KiB 原始字节的 base64；后续块必须携带同 revision，变化即冲突。pending 持久化暂时不可读。begin/append/abort 复用全局 ConfigUploads 配额与两分钟期限；只有 append 请求允许 68 KiB 正文，其余 4 KiB。commit 后台任务以 uploadId 去重，同 requestId 异参冲突；status 只读查询且 null 不证明未执行。任务终态后需重新读取规则与设备状态；COMMIT_UNCERTAIN 可能已经生效，不重放。targets 包含停止 VM，当前控制通道只支持其第一个控制器，null 表示无控制器；不读取 sysfs 或触发旧规则预览的驱动恢复。

200.description: 规则元数据/分块/暂存或任务查询结果，携带同会话 context。

202.description: 已登记规则提交任务，尚不代表持久化或设备应用完成。

post.description: 管理员且具有任务权限，最多 4096 字节。目标为宿主、空闲或目录中的运行 VM；复用 TaskService requestId 去重，去掉 requestId 后的规范化签名最多 1024 字节。同 ID 不同条件/目标返回冲突。执行在 USB 串行队列中检查设备枚举、VID/PID、占用/锁定及目标 VM 实例版本，失配任务失败为 CONFLICT。返回任务完成并非热插拔预留，刷新目录查看实际状态；丢回执仅查询同 requestId，不自动重发。

202.description: 已登记后台任务

get.description: 仅查询当前调用者的任务，不执行 USB 操作；null 表示未找到或记录已过期，不能据此认定之前未执行。

200.description: USB 任务记录或 null

get.description: 管理员只读宿主 USB 目录。复用原生扫描与归属投影，排除集线器，不触发驱动恢复/规则应用/直通操作。最多 4096 项、2 MiB，id 由 sysfs 位置及设备枚举编号组成，不能用 VID/PID/序列号代替本次插入身份。state=claimed 仅表示 usbfs 用户态占用，owner=null 时不能认定属于某个 VM。available=false 表示服务未启动/已停止或设备目录不可用，此时 items 为空。

200.description: 宿主 USB 设备及当前归属

get.description: 管理员只读设备目录，复用原生 AudioTable 的缓存，不在 HTTP 请求中查询 Binder。最多 1024 项、2 MiB；仅投影可选择的稳定键/名称/方向/种类，按方向和键去重。available=false 表示尚未就绪、服务不可用或缓存超过 5 秒，此时 items 为空。没有设备预留或录音权限授权副作用。

200.description: 当前宿主音频设备

get.description: host.cpu.v1：管理员只读 sysfs 核心目录，与原生启动共用频率/容量探测。最多 4096 核心，目录枚举最多 16384 项，单文件最多 64 KiB；无目录返回 unavailable，不使用运行时处理器数量猜测索引。频率、容量、在线状态未知为 null，容量估算沿用最大频率比。读取是即时观察，不保证热插拔原子快照，不预留核心或修改绑定。

200.description: 宿主 CPU 核心

get.description: host.devices.v1，管理员观察。设备节点/驱动文件存在性为 true/false，读取无法确定时为 null；不代表驱动可加载、虚拟化支持或渲染成功。与启动共用检测，不返回宿主路径。系统 Vulkan 扩展探测复用 App 核心，在独立子进程运行，每个 daemon 生命周期首次请求异步启动一次；5 秒超时、每流 32 KiB 输出，崩溃/超时/失败为 unknown，HTTP 不等待驱动。刷新不重新执行已完成探测。只枚举物理设备/扩展，不创建逻辑设备、Surface、虚拟机或改写配置。扩展齐全也不等同于完整渲染可用。

200.description: 宿主设备与缓存扩展观察

get.description: 管理员只读资源目录，最多 4096 项、投影正文 2 MiB；超额返回错误，不截断。不代表资源运行态或文件探测结果。

200.description: 当前资源登记列表

get.description: 管理员只读资源目录，最多 4096 项、投影正文 2 MiB；超额返回错误，不截断。不代表资源运行态或文件探测结果。

200.description: 当前资源登记列表

post.description: 管理员配置通道，所有操作含 Origin/CSRF/context。read 创建/续读已有 TaskService 固定文档快照（最多 16 MiB），用 release 释放。begin/append/abort 复用与 App 相同的 ConfigUploads 配额与 2 分钟期限；append 最多 48 KiB 原始字节且不写配置。commit 仅接纳 TaskService 后台任务，同会话 requestId 去重；status 只读查询，null 不证明未执行。提交完整文档要求固定 revision，沿用原有配置协调器、运行态及依赖校验。前端须保留未知字段/大整数，未知结果只查询不自动重提。

200.description: 默认草稿/分块读取/暂存/查询结果，含会话 context。

202.description: 配置提交任务已接纳，不代表已经持久化。

get.description: WebSocket 子协议 droidvm.events.v1；必须匹配 Host/Origin/Cookie，无 query。第一条文本消息为 EventSubscribe（最多 4096 字节），后续客户端业务帧关闭连接。服务端 EventNotification 不包含原始任务事件/异常/owner。ready/resync 后重新读取资源基线；invalidate 后读取所列资源。每 15 秒心跳，不延长会话有效期。每连接一个有界工作/输出，过慢关闭。断线仅重连订阅，禁止重放写操作。

101.description: WebSocket 已升级；收到合法 subscribe 后开始发通知。

200.description: 当前 VM 实例的文本日志流；不返回宿主路径、FD 或内部 agent 协议流。

requestBody.description: 只读请求；参数与身份上下文在 JSON 中，不改变日志或创建任务。tail 只允许与 null cursor 同用。

200.description: 同一日志锁内的游标与最多 64 KiB 原始字节（base64）。原生只保留最近 1 MiB；清空/覆盖时 reset=true，前端不得拼接旧内容。

409.description: VM 实例改变或身份/进程改变；重新读取流列表，不混合旧实例内容。

202.description: 原生任务已接纳；任务成功仅表示生命周期调用接纳，不代表 VM 已达到目标状态。同会话、同 requestId、同参数在任务保留期复用原任务；变更参数冲突。禁止自动重放写请求。

200.description: 仅查询当前会话发起的请求；null 表示当前无记录，不能证明没有执行，也不能据此重放写入。
一次固定快照的完整任务投影，内部有界分页后立即释放快照。最多 1024 项、原始行合计 1 MiB，超额失败而非静默截断。保留期沿用 TaskService；缺失任务不代表未执行。
取消后的实际任务状态。cancelling 仍在清理，不代表 cancelled；已经完成的任务返回其原状态。丢失响应后仅查询，不自动重放。

409.description: context_changed 或 not_cancellable；没有提交本次取消。

200.description: 已认证浏览器的实际 WebUI 能力，不复制本机 IPC 权限或命令。Cache-Control: no-store。
VM 列表投影及请求所属会话/daemon epoch；未获得的字段返回 null。
当前浏览器会话与内存 CSRF token，Cache-Control: no-store。

get.description: Restore an existing browser session. With LAN auto-login enabled, a directly connected peer may receive a temporary LAN session only with X-DroidVM-Session: 1, matching Origin when present, same-origin Fetch Metadata when present, and no local logout suppression cookie.

requestBody.description: 4 KiB 上限；配对凭据只放 JSON，不放 URL。

201.description: 单次兑换成功。Cookie 为 droidvm-session=<opaque>; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict，无 Domain/Secure。JSON 不返回 Cookie 凭据。

204.description: 会话立即吊销，同名/同 Path Cookie 以 Max-Age=0 删除。

post.description: networks.deletion.v1; administrator and task permissions, Origin/CSRF/context. Shared native staged coordinated deletion. Does not bypass VM dependencies; confirmation uses exact saved network and VM revision. May disconnect browser. Recovery is a separate explicit operation.

200.description: Snapshot, staging or scoped task status with session context.

202.description: 配置提交任务已接纳，不代表已经持久化。

post.description: configuration.recovery.v1; administrator and task permissions, Origin/CSRF/context. Explicit global configuration journal redo, not rollback or replay of deletion. Queued task cancellable; executing recovery not cancellable. Reread configuration to determine outcome.

202.description: Global configuration recovery task accepted; success does not imply original deletion succeeded.

200.description: 当前身份的恢复任务；null 不证明未执行

get.description: vm.terminal.v1; administrator. Only current RUNNING bidirectional serial streams, excluding internal agent. STOPPED has no streams. Native incarnation and revision freeze the console; only local rendering can resize, no guest TTY resize support.

200.description: Session-bound serial metadata.

get.description: Authenticated WebSocket droidvm.terminal.v1. Origin/Cookie validated before upgrade, first VmTerminalOpen checks CSRF/context. Native state/instance/revision validated for read/write; no internal agent stream. Input is 1..512 raw base64 bytes with strict per-connection sequence; actual accepted bytes acknowledged, no replay after unknown or partial input. Client acknowledges each rendered output via VmTerminalOutputAck; only one output chunk in flight. Explicit reconnect may resume output cursor, never unacknowledged input. Idle heartbeat does not extend session lifetime.

101.description: WebSocket upgraded; first frame required before data.

post.description: capability agent.operations.v1。管理员及任务权限、Origin/CSRF/context；请求最多4 KiB。请求ID只可提交一次，重复POST拒绝；回执未知时只GET定向查询，不得自动重放密码或操作。使用确认时的磁盘与VM版本。

202.description: Agent任务已接收；不是客体动作成功或持久化完成

409.description: 重复请求标识、版本冲突或上下文变化；不得重提原POST

200.description: 当前身份关联任务；null 不证明操作未发生

get.description: 只查询当前身份此前requestId。task为null不证明操作未执行，禁止因此重复POST；不接收密码。

200.description: 持久日志记录数，可能包含活动任务；只读，不触发恢复

get.description: capability agent.recovery.v1。只读Agent清理记录数量，可能包含活动任务；不暴露密码、原始串口、宿主路径或VM配置。

post.description: 管理员及任务权限、Origin/CSRF/context；最多4 KiB。显式处理Agent清理记录，不重跑客体动作、不重放密码；重复POST拒绝，未知回执仅GET查询。进入执行后不可取消。

202.description: 恢复任务已接收；剩余记录数见定向任务结果

409.description: 重复请求标识或上下文变化

200.description: 当前身份的恢复任务；null 不证明未执行

get.description: 当前身份的Agent恢复任务；null不证明未执行，禁止自动重复POST。

agent.rescue.v1; administrator and task permission. Lists only the current principal's existing registry sessions. Reads never refresh the 15-minute lifetime. Expired/closing sessions reject console access.

200.description: Private rescue sessions.

get.description: agent.rescue.v1; same-principal private rescue session only. VmTerminalMetadata.vmId is the rescue session ID, never the managed VM ID. Only uart; expired/closing sessions unavailable.

200.description: Session-bound serial metadata.

get.description: agent.rescue.v1. Same droidvm.terminal.v1 frames, ACK and no-replay rules as /terminal, but VmTerminalOpen.vmId is a private rescue session ID and only uart is allowed. Origin/Cookie/CSRF/context and registry ownership/lifetime are checked. Disconnect/reconnect never extends the session lifetime or repeats input.

101.description: WebSocket upgraded; first frame required before data.

post.description: agent.rescue.v1; administrator and task permission; Origin/CSRF/context required. Existing background TaskService performs host cleanup. Unknown response must be resolved with GET, never POST replay. Task kind agent_rescue_close; agentRescueCleanup is host evidence only, not guest unmount/durability.

202.description: Agent任务已接收；不是客体动作成功或持久化完成

409.description: 重复请求标识、版本冲突或上下文变化；不得重提原POST

200.description: 当前身份关联任务；null 不证明操作未发生

get.description: Find this principal's prior rescue-close task by request ID. null does not prove cleanup never ran; do not resubmit automatically.
packages.export.v1; administrator and manageTasks. Configuration-only plan with VM, disk and network revisions; does not scan files or backing chains.

200.description: Session-bound export choices from current configuration.

post.description: packages.export.v1; administrator and manageTasks. Same-origin Cookie/CSRF/context; maximum body 32 KiB. Explicit overwrite acknowledgement and VM/disk/network confirmation required. Reuses the native package task. After an unknown response, only look up requestId; never automatically replay POST.

202.description: Native package export task accepted; files are written on the Android host.

409.description: A confirmed configuration changed, or the requestId belongs to another request.

200.description: The matching package task or null, scoped to the current identity.

get.description: Read the caller-owned vm_export task for a prior requestId. Null does not establish that a prior POST did not execute; do not automatically replay it. Only successful tasks expose packageExport.volumeCount, never raw native results or error text.

post.description: packages.import.v1; administrator and manageTasks. Same-origin Cookie/CSRF/context; maximum 32 KiB. Submits native package_import_plan task directly. Each requestId may be submitted only once; after an unknown response only GET the same requestId. No browser manifest/configuration accepted.

202.description: Native task accepted. Completion and bounded receipts are available through GET by requestId.

409.description: Repeated requestId, incompatible network selection, or changed confirmation/source.

200.description: Matching task and bounded operation projection, or null.

get.description: Read this caller-owned package_import_plan task. Null does not prove that a POST did not run. Do not automatically replay; raw native results and exception messages are never returned.

post.description: packages.import.v1; administrator and manageTasks. Same-origin Cookie/CSRF/context; maximum 32 KiB. Submits native vm_import task directly. Each requestId may be submitted only once; after an unknown response only GET the same requestId. No browser manifest/configuration accepted. planRequestId must identify a retained successful preview owned by this caller. Stale configuration or source observations reject execution.

202.description: Native task accepted. Completion and bounded receipts are available through GET by requestId.

409.description: Repeated requestId, incompatible network selection, or changed confirmation/source.

200.description: Matching task and bounded operation projection, or null.

get.description: Read this caller-owned vm_import task. Null does not prove that a POST did not run. Do not automatically replay; raw native results and exception messages are never returned.

post.description: packages.transfer.v1; Cookie/Origin/CSRF/context required. Reserve browser-selected package files with exact sizes. requestId is the public transfer ID, not its filesystem directory. Maximum request 384 KiB. Duplicate begin conflicts; after an unknown response GET that ID instead of reposting.

200.description: Current identity-scoped transfer state.

post.description: packages.transfer.v1; Cookie/Origin/CSRF/context required. Maximum JSON request 384 KiB; decode at most 256 KiB. Unknown chunk response: GET state and compare exact offset before continuing. Never blindly replay a chunk.

200.description: Current identity-scoped transfer state.

post.description: packages.transfer.v1; Cookie/Origin/CSRF/context required. Validate a complete package/volume set and return ready plus host source for import preview. Unknown finish response: only GET automatically; a user may explicitly retry finish after all offsets are confirmed complete.

200.description: Current identity-scoped transfer state.

post.description: packages.transfer.v1; Cookie/Origin/CSRF/context required. Pin a completed caller-owned vm_export output and its known volume files. Maximum request 384 KiB. No arbitrary host path is accepted. Each transfer ID may be prepared only once.

200.description: Current identity-scoped transfer state.

get.description: Read current caller-owned transfer state; never replay a mutation.

200.description: Current identity-scoped transfer state.

delete.description: Cookie/Origin/CSRF required; empty body. Release upload files only when unused; pinned preview/import sources reject deletion and remain ready.

get.description: Read current caller-owned transfer state; never replay a mutation.

200.description: Current identity-scoped transfer state.

delete.description: Cookie/Origin/CSRF required; empty body. Release retained download handles without deleting export files. Active readers stop; busy records may report conflict/closing until readers release.

get.description: Same-origin attachment with cookie authentication and no URL credential. Origin may be absent for browser navigation; a supplied foreign origin is rejected. Owner/session/listener generation and retained file identity are checked for each bounded background read. HEAD is rejected without opening a reader. Range is rejected, no resume. Read failure after headers terminates the connection without appending JSON.

200.description: Streaming file with a 64-bit Content-Length and bounded memory.

schema.description: Canonical nonnegative uint64 decimal; at most 18446744073709551615.

post.description: configuration.backup.v1; administrator/task permissions, Origin/CSRF/context. App version 1 JSON bytes are preserved exactly; import at most 31 MiB in raw chunks up to 48 KiB (68 KiB append HTTP body). Shared native ConfigUploads quota and expiry. Preview freezes three revisions and an opaque token; commit consumes that preview once. Networks commit before the joint VM/disk transaction, so terminal failure may report completed categories. Unknown commit acknowledgement permits status queries only; null is not evidence that the operation did not execute. No raw backup content or exception messages in task results.

200.description: Identity-scoped configuration backup response.

post.description: configuration.backup.v1; administrator/task permissions, Origin/CSRF/context. App version 1 JSON bytes are preserved exactly; import at most 31 MiB in raw chunks up to 48 KiB (68 KiB append HTTP body). Shared native ConfigUploads quota and expiry. Preview freezes three revisions and an opaque token; commit consumes that preview once. Networks commit before the joint VM/disk transaction, so terminal failure may report completed categories. Unknown commit acknowledgement permits status queries only; null is not evidence that the operation did not execute. No raw backup content or exception messages in task results.

App version 1 JSON bytes are preserved exactly; import at most 31 MiB in raw chunks up to 48 KiB (68 KiB append HTTP body). Shared native ConfigUploads quota and expiry. Preview freezes three revisions and an opaque token; commit consumes that preview once. Networks commit before the joint VM/disk transaction, so terminal failure may report completed categories. Unknown commit acknowledgement permits status queries only; null is not evidence that the operation did not execute. No raw backup content or exception messages in task results.

get.description: configuration.backup.v1; native fixed consistent VM/disk/network snapshot in the App version 1 envelope. At most 33 MiB encoded and one retained export per service. Browser attachment download, bounded stream blocks, session checked before and after every block; no range/resume support. Export may exceed the 31 MiB import limit; no saved configuration is silently truncated. HEAD is rejected without opening a snapshot.

200.description: Fixed UTF-8 configuration backup attachment.

get.description: web.service.v1; administrator and task permissions. Read service settings and actual listener state. During deferred application addresses still name the active listener. No session secrets, pairing tokens, local-admin impersonation or local IPC access.

200.description: Identity-scoped service observation or task receipt.

post.description: web.service.v1; administrator/task permissions, Origin/CSRF/context. Maximum request 16 KiB. expected is the exact prior settings value. restart requires settings==expected. Owner/requestId/signature deduplication; task success only confirms settings saved and application queued. A later maintenance step can close the current connection and invalidate browser sessions. Read status again to observe the new listener. Unknown acknowledgement is queried only and is never automatically replayed; null does not prove non-execution. COMMIT_UNCERTAIN requires App-side settings reload.

get.description: vm.display.v1; authenticated WebSocket droidvm.display.v1. Cookie/Origin checked before upgrade. First text VmDisplayOpen verifies CSRF/context/observed instance and screen; after connection succeeds, a single text VmDisplayReady carries optional-empty password in memory. Thereafter both directions are ordered binary RFB, maximum 64 KiB per message. No JSON/base64 RFB envelopes, credentials in URLs, arbitrary endpoints or automatic reconnect/replay. At most two displays per browser session and sixteen native connections globally. Native callbacks revalidate RUNNING/instance/revision before every I/O; periodic liveness also runs under output backpressure. Five-second connect deadline, ten-second native-write stall deadline, bounded network output stall, one-hour absolute display lifetime. Input queue has byte/frame quotas; excessive pressure closes the channel. No audio, clipboard promise or native Android Surface mirroring is implied.
